_about: A colosseum run (core/colosseum_rules.gd decides). tickets: bought with points at the painting; a run is the first `waves` waves of data/waves.json and ends with the reward chest. per_wave: every wave after the first makes its enemies this much tougher (0.12 = +12 % of the wave-1 number per wave). loot: tiers = the ladder, lowest first (pony is never reached by stepping up). trash_chance = share of ordinary kills that leave a gun; elites and bosses always leave one. bands: up to wave `to_wave` a gun is of `tier`, with chance `better` one tier higher. A boss's gun is boss_tiers_up above its wave's tier. final_boss: the boss of wave `wave` leaves `guns` guns picked by the weights in `tiers`, and with chance `treasure_chance` the item `treasure`. chest: `guns` guns chest_tiers_up above the tier of the run's last wave. armour: the chance that a kill also leaves a piece of armour (any armour item of data/items.json without no_drop), and slot_trait_chance = the share of those that are the variant with one more ready gun slot (data/items.json variants). modifiers: ticked on the board before going in; `loot` = the share each adds to every loot chance (all chances x (1 + the sum); the chest gets one more gun per chest.gun_per_loot of that sum); `effects` = what it changes, read by core/colosseum_rules.gd `effects` (numbers of the same key multiply): enemy_health / enemy_damage / enemy_speed (x), death_blast_radius + death_blast_damage (a dead enemy blows up), all_elite, player_health (x), ammo_start (share of every pool you start with), fog (density) + hide_bars, boss_count / enemy_count (x heads per wave), no_heal, wave_seconds + late_pack (too slow = that many elites more), boss_body_damage (x unless it is a headshot), vampire (share of a blow's damage the enemy heals), wave_delay (seconds between waves), blackout, ring_start / ring_end (metres, first to last wave) + ring_dps, still_seconds + still_element, berserk_below (share of health) + berserk_mult, blind, reload_time (x), jump_fatigue (x) + no_sprint.

modifiers.name: Thick Hides
modifiers.desc: Every enemy has 50 % more health.

modifiers.name: Heavy Hitters
modifiers.desc: Every enemy hits 50 % harder.

modifiers.name: Quick Feet
modifiers.desc: Every enemy moves 30 % faster.

modifiers.name: Bad Blood
modifiers.desc: An enemy blows up where it dies: 18 damage to you if you stand within 3.5 m.

modifiers.name: All Elite
modifiers.desc: Every enemy gets an elite trait (tough, swift, brutal or giant), but only true elites drop elite loot.

modifiers.name: Glass Jaw
modifiers.desc: Your health is halved for the whole run.

modifiers.name: Dry Mags
modifiers.desc: You go in with only half of every ammo pool (nothing refills it in there).

modifiers.name: Fog Bank
modifiers.desc: Thick fog over the arena, and no health bars over the enemies.

modifiers.name: Twin Bosses
modifiers.desc: Every boss wave has two bosses instead of one.

modifiers.name: Packed House
modifiers.desc: Every wave has 50 % more enemies.

modifiers.name: One Life
modifiers.desc: Nothing heals you during the run: no regeneration, no healing items.

modifiers.name: Short Fuse
modifiers.desc: Each wave has 45 seconds: too slow and 3 more enemies of that wave's kinds come in.

modifiers.name: Bulletproof Bosses
modifiers.desc: Bosses take half damage from body shots; headshots do full damage.

modifiers.name: Vampires
modifiers.desc: Enemies heal themselves by the damage they deal to you.

modifiers.name: No Breather
modifiers.desc: The next wave starts the moment the last one is beaten.

modifiers.name: Blackout
modifiers.desc: The arena goes dark: you see by a torch on your head and the muzzle flashes.

modifiers.name: Closing Ring
modifiers.desc: A ring of fire shrinks every wave (26 m across at the start down to 9 m): outside it you burn for 14 a second.

modifiers.name: Toxic Sand
modifiers.desc: Stand still for 2 seconds and the sand poisons you; keep moving.

modifiers.name: Berserkers
modifiers.desc: An enemy below 30 % health moves and hits twice as hard.

modifiers.name: Blind Fire
modifiers.desc: No crosshair, no ammo counter and no gun bar on your screen.

modifiers.name: Slow Hands
modifiers.desc: Reloading takes 50 % longer.

modifiers.name: Lead Boots
modifiers.desc: Jumping tires you twice as fast, and you cannot sprint.
